hypothesis: An opt-in, bounded evidence receipt wrapper over the qualified RET03 single cumulative native model can durably record truly prior-issued first-step and second-step probabilities, independently staged observed outcomes, their two-clock Brier losses and before/after native checkpoint hashes; the scorer never recomputes predictions with revealed answers and never changes RET03/native training.
model_interface: Same RET03 StagedTemporalReadout; no new predictor/weights/control policy. Exactly the same begin/record_transition/choose_second/complete calls, observed at matching chronology.
score_rule: For each arm archive/live/temporal at completion, transition_loss=(P_at_begin(s2=1) - witnessed_s2)^2; reward_loss=(P_at_second(y=1) - witnessed_y)^2; staged_brier=(transition_loss+reward_loss)/2; use ordered subtraction and multiplication; no post-update predictions or access to future unobserved outcomes.

receipt_schema.source_id: 64 lowercase hex SHA identity, not source-owner signature
receipt_schema.prior_native_sha256: hash of exact original RET02 native/readout checkpoint BEFORE terminal outcome
receipt_schema.first_forecast: exact returned immutable P(s2) at begin
receipt_schema.second_forecast: exact returned immutable P(y) after s2 before y

new_tests: two-stage score arithmetic from issued predictions
recording only on completed authenticated-form public receipts (not signed original lease)
no new native or readout update before completion
three-arm split-stage Brier differs from post-reveal reforecast where applicable
cold exact replay and forged rehash rejection of forecasts/scores/history
native after-state same as RET03 direct complete and trained prefix unchanged
bounded 64 source budget; source checkpoint limits

scientific_gate.if_authorized: independently source-owner-approved unfamiliar causal worlds with action reservations, per-stage public prequential clocks, same-information fully fitted baseline controls, cold old-rule retention, source budget and stop thresholds

frozen_stop: Do not retune previous RET01/RET02/RET03 scored development traces, do not treat constructed fixtures as evidence of scientific gain; no additional model or controller.
